title: Australia maintains 2027 international student planning level at 295,000
summary_en: The Australian government keeps the National Planning Level unchanged at 295,000 after saying international student commencements are on track to remain below it, while confirming no active provider will receive a lower allocation in 2027.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: Australia maintains 2027 international student planning level at 295,000

title: TNE drives UK export growth as international enrolment revenue slows
summary_en: The UK's total education exports grew modestly in 2024 to reach £36.7 billion, as the government eyes its target of £40 billion by the end of the decade.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: TNE drives UK export growth as international enrolment revenue slows

title: Preview: The PIE Live Asia Pacific 2026 set for blockbuster year
summary_en: Lights, camera, action! The PIE team will descend on the sunny Gold Coast for our fourth instalment of our Asia Pacific conference, taking place on 28-29 July 2026 at HOTA: Home of The Arts - a premier cinema and theatre venue.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert
title_cn: Preview: The PIE Live Asia Pacific 2026 set for blockbuster year

title: Burkina Faso orders students to seek approval before studying abroad
summary_en: New decree brings all outbound students – including those who are self-funded – under ministerial authorisation as the government says it seeks to align overseas education with national development priorities.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: Burkina Faso orders students to seek approval before studying abroad

title: ‘Not your cash cow, Not your scapegoat’: a reckoning for Canadian higher education
summary_en: Eight years in the making, a new book by the RAIS Collective offers one of the most comprehensive examinations yet of how international students in Canada have navigated racism, exclusion and shifting political narratives.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: ‘Not your cash cow, Not your scapegoat’: a reckoning for Canadian higher education

title: “Frustration, disappointment, even heartbreak”: Ian Aird on Australia’s latest visa fee hike
summary_en: The ELICOS sector has reacted strongly to Australia’s latest student visa fee increases, with English Australia CEO Ian Aird describing “frustration” across providers.
author: Ian Aird
title_cn: “Frustration, disappointment, even heartbreak”: Ian Aird on Australia’s latest visa fee hike

title: BorderPlus maps out global expansion with training-first healthcare mobility model
summary_en: BorderPlus, co-founded by upGrad co-founder Mayank Kumar, is building on its presence in Germany, the GCC and Japan, with the UK, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Italy, France, and South Korea among the markets it is looking to target over the longer term.
